chart.summary: Engram is a local AI-maintained repository Cortex with compact bounded JSON snapshots, an offline local runtime, revision-safe mutations, task-focused retrieval, a persistent MCP interface, optional recoverable audit history, and separate explicit-Cortex retrieval indexes; it never scans, parses, or infers from source code.

areas.label: Cortex storage
areas.summary: The CLI persists a bounded compact JSON Cortex and exposes revision-safe read, replace, apply, validate, status, and atomic mutation locking.

areas.label: Cerebellum
areas.summary: init installs the Cerebellum, which tells agents how to form and maintain the Cortex.

areas.label: Performance tooling
areas.summary: The repeatable benchmark measures direct storage and fresh-CLI p50/p95 latency across controlled Cortex sizes; the performance report records current evidence and architecture decisions.

areas.label: Persistent MCP service
areas.summary: engram-mcp is a persistent stdio MCP server that exposes structured Cortex reads, safe mutations, validation, and history verification without fresh CLI startup per tool call.

areas.label: Audit and retrieval
areas.summary: Optional content-addressed history records safe mutations with recovery checkpoints every 50 events; explicit Cortex roots can produce a separate derived search index without source scanning.

areas.label: Local runtime and task focus
areas.summary: init copies the dependency-free CLI/runtime into .engram/runtime so ordinary Cortex work is independent of npm and network state. focus returns a bounded, ranked slice of agent-authored entries for task navigation; it never opens source files.

workflows.label: Bootstrap
workflows.summary: A user runs init once. The installed local runtime performs all subsequent reads, focused retrieval, safe mutations, and validation without repeatedly resolving an npm or GitHub package.

workflows.label: Maintenance
workflows.summary: Agents read a fresh revision before every Cortex mutation; stale or overlapping writes return explicit conflicts instead of losing durable facts. Optional history records audited changes.

workflows.label: Benchmarking
workflows.summary: Run npm run bench to measure isolated temporary Cortex workloads without scanning or mutating source repositories.

workflows.label: Cross-repository retrieval
workflows.summary: A caller explicitly lists repository roots to build a derived Cortex index and searches that artifact; the indexer reads only Cortex snapshots.

workflows.label: Task navigation
workflows.summary: At the start of an investigation, an agent queries focus with distinctive task terms, opens cited evidence paths, and verifies facts in source. After discovering a recurring boundary or test seam, it updates the Cortex so related future work can start from that anchor.

decisions.label: Agent-owned knowledge
decisions.summary: All repository understanding is authored and maintained by agents, not derived by Engram from code.

decisions.label: Compact JSON for agents
decisions.summary: The Cortex uses compact named-field JSON with hard AI working-set limits because it is directly reliable agent context; denser encodings and a Rust rewrite remain unjustified by the measured storage path.

decisions.label: Revisioned mutations
decisions.summary: All apply and replace operations require the read snapshot revision and use an exclusive local lock; this favors explicit agent recovery over silent last-write-wins data loss.

decisions.label: Self-contained installed runtime
decisions.summary: The bootstrap command may come from npx or a package install, but init must make normal Cortex operation self-contained in the target repository. This prevents npm-cache, registry, and GitHub-resolution failures from blocking agents after setup.

conventions.label: Minimal docs
conventions.summary: README and docs stay concise; the Cerebellum contains the operative workflow.

conventions.label: Performance evidence
conventions.summary: Performance claims use the repeatable benchmark with p50/p95 measurements and distinguish in-process safe workflows from fresh CLI read-plus-apply latency.
